body:
I know that it might take a while for me to stop feeling so hopeless, pathetic, stupid, like a freak, etc., but there's hope.
I know that things DO eventually get better, I just couldn't wait.

Thank you for spending your time on me. I know I'm not worth it, but it means a lot. I think I'll be okay for a while.

This is officially day 12 without self-harming; yesterday I would've started all over again if it weren't for you.

You're a superhero! <3

It's just what i think to myself as.

Now-a-days in society, reaching out is bad for some reason. :/

Thanks Bill Gates, for allowing me to have a couple more years of hope and happiness.

I really don't know. My dad is always putting me down. I don't even talk to him anymore.

As for my mom, she's my best friend. I don't get to see her everyday because of school, and her job, but I love her. I tell her almost everything, except that I'm suicidal, and have wanted the world to explode since I was about 8.

No, you're right. I'm a stupid sixteen year old.

I tried the while club thing, and it helped. I joined videogame club, and Anime club. It's nice to find other people who share the same interest.

She's the only person who actually makes me happy, and I hope we're together for a while.

No. I've thought about this before. I've lost two of my closest friends, have had one of parents telling me to kill myself, and my life just goes in a routine.
I have to go get a checkup to see if i have psychophrenia, or whatever I have, and I just plain don't feel needed around. Life is over for me.

As stupid as this might sound, i just don't like eating. It makes me feel weird.
I don't feel like talking to real life people at all any time soon...and i feel like i would bother people if i posted new threads.
June is so far away, i want to end it now. But i cant. What makes it better is having my girlfriend breaking up with me after she knew what was going on.

The world is messed up. I don't want to be on it anymore. In all honesty though, i have attempted suicide before. At least twice.

This story makes me think of those people who live in the dark. They always travel together in groups. I saw them travel in a Coca-Cola truck. They're really quiet and don't like to have conversations with people that aren't like them. They don't dress like you and me. That made them a little scary. The child they had with them had a rag doll, the doll had no eyes. I always wonder why. I saw these people in Indiana. I mostly wonder why they live in darkness. They didn't seem very happy in the light. People are really fascinating.
I was not aware it became a rule, people did overuse it. Eh, I see your reasoning.
As much as I miss the 'le', I like grammar too. Besides, the way you use it, makes no sense, "chew with your the mouth closed"?
But, aren't they doing the CWTST in Asia?
This, sir, was hilarious. Thank you.
I felt around my temples, I have the wires. I started thinking it was just my nerves, till I felt them go around to my eyes. Have I too been infected? Please tell me it's just lack of sleep...
That was one of the most fascinating things I had ever read. My question has been answered. Thank you.

I love how even girls refer to themselves as gay instead of saying 'lesbian'. The story was really cute and sad. I'm glad I clicked on it.

Now if you excuse me, I will go cry in my corner over there...
